ratio_definition: baseline median / candidate median; >1 favors candidate
scope_notes: Final results are included only when a distinct completed third campaign is supplied; they precede initial results.
The initial tiny-call Correlated Hyperfine gain is not corroborated by Go medians.
Retain initial MaskedArithmetic, RotatedField, and PackedHeaders negative results.
Environment, affinity, protocol, compiler, and source hashes belong to each campaign; missing historical fields remain missing.
Compiler RSS is one diagnostic per side; package coverage is exactly the recorded workloads.
Hash manifests identify the working sources but do not archive a full source tree or compiler binary.
C1/C2 lack extended compiler-input verification; later compile_input_freeze events preserve their exact hashes and recheck scope.
Numeric protocol compliance does not make an uncorroborated or negative result a speedup.
source_hashes_reconstruction: Merge source_hashes_common with each campaign source_hashes_additions_or_overrides.
status: public measurement evidence; private metadata redacted

redaction.scope: Private absolute paths, local campaign identifiers, host/kernel identity, and raw process-log wrappers were removed or replaced with labeled portable placeholders.
redaction.numeric_integrity: Every original JSON numeric token is preserved byte-for-byte at the corresponding recursively mapped field. Printed Go benchmark rows retain their original numeric spelling.
redaction.hash_integrity: All original SHA-256 values are preserved. They and original byte counts describe the recorded artifacts, not a recomputed hash or size of the redacted representation.
redaction.retained_configuration: CPU model, OS/architecture, optimization flags, affinity, GOMAXPROCS, GOGC, GOMEMLIMIT, workload counts, outcomes, and timing/allocation observations are retained.
redaction.path_placeholders: <REPO_ROOT>, <CAMPAIGN_F>, <CAMPAIGN_C1>, <CAMPAIGN_C2>, <EVIDENCE_ROOT>, <EXTRACTION_DIR>, <GO_CACHE>, <GO_TMPDIR>, <TEST_TMPDIR>, <MEASURED_RUNNER>, <HYPERFINE_BIN>, <WORKSPACE>, and any <PRIVATE_PATH_N> are portable labels, not literal executable paths.
redaction.source_and_logs: Exact measured runner source and private raw logs are not embedded in this public record. Public pprof summaries omit identity headers; Go output is restricted to benchmark rows, elapsed observations, and outcomes.
